doc: judge_surface(ref, maps): one row per judged metric (SURFACE_JUDGED order, params.judged; inputs hold the columns params.keys: the six judged ones then the two season terms). v = the metric over the maps; spread = sample std (ddof 1; NaN for one map); season = |ref[season term]| or 0; tolerance = max(2.2 * spread, floor) + season with floor 2.5 for itcz_lat and 0.01 otherwise; diff = mean(v) - ref; pass = tolerance finite and |diff| <= tolerance. Python max(nan, floor) is NaN (the first argument wins when a comparison fails): do not port it as floor. Float64 arithmetic on a handful of numbers: 1e-9; no verdict sits within 1e-6 of a tie, except in exact_ties and just_over_ties, which sit ON one (or an ulp past it) by construction, from exactly representable operations. Three identical maps: spread 0, so the tolerance is the floor (0.01, 2.5 for itcz_lat) plus the season allowance (0.10, 0.05): land_minus_ocean (diff 0) passes, subtropics_land_minus_ocean (diff 0.23 against 0.01) misses, the two season-widened metrics (diff 0.01) and itcz_lat (diff 1.0 against 2.5) pass.
